name: Samara Oblast
verdict: Brand and coat of arms of the Samara Oblast government — a founder of HC Lada and a funder of the club from the regional budget — worn across the front of the 2026-27 home jersey.
note: Front-of-shirt branding is the full 'САМАРСКАЯ ОБЛАСТЬ' name with the regional coat of arms (KHL 2026/27 kit render; club match-gallery photos, September 2026). The club lists the region as a founder ('Учредитель ХК «Лада»'). Regional-lawmaker and press reporting document direct budget funding of the club (750m RUB for the 2023/24 return season; renewed support pledged in May 2026).
